timeout.description: Timeout in tenths of a second (e.g., 50 = 5 seconds) before auto-booting the default entry. 0 disables timeout.

prompt.description: Whether to always display the 'boot:' prompt (true) or only on key press/lock (false).

global_append.description: Global kernel command line options appended to all entries.

labels.description: List of boot entries to generate in the configuration file. If empty, no label sections are generated, relying on global settings or manual booting.

labels_items.description: Definition for a single boot label entry in the labels list. Not used directly as a top-level variable but defines the schema for items in the 'labels' list.

label.description: The label name used to identify this boot entry at the prompt.

kernel.description: The path to the kernel image file relative to the SYSLINUX installation directory.

append.description: Kernel command line options specific to this label entry. If empty, inherits from global_append.
